title: Alex / Priya — Weekly 1:1
segments: Hey Priya, how's your week going so far?
Pretty good, honestly. Busy, but a good kind of busy. The release went smoothly, which was a relief after last time.
It really did. The rollback plan you wrote was a big part of that. I shared it with the platform team as an example of how to do it.
Thanks, that means a lot. I wanted to talk about two things today: my growth plan and the on-call rotation.
Sure, let's start with the growth plan. Last time you mentioned wanting to move toward a tech lead role.

Yes. I've been thinking about it more, and I want to lead the search infrastructure project next quarter. I know the indexing code better than anyone, and I have ideas for moving to incremental indexing.
I think that's a great fit. The thing I'd want to see is you driving the design review and getting buy-in from the platform team, not just writing the code.
That makes sense. I've never run a design review on my own, though. Is there a template we use?
There is. I'll send you the design doc template and two good examples from last year. I'd suggest drafting the doc by the end of the month so we can review it together before it goes wider.
Okay, I'll aim to have a first draft by the twenty-eighth.
Great. And I'll talk to Marcus about pairing with you on it, since he built the original search service.
That would be really helpful. Now the on-call rotation. I've been paged four times in the last two weeks, and three were for the same alert on the transcript queue.
That's too many. Is the alert actually useful or is it noise?
Mostly noise. It fires when the queue depth goes above fifty, but the queue always drains on its own within ten minutes. I think we should alert on queue age instead of depth.
I agree. Can you open a ticket to change the alert to queue age, and we'll put it in next sprint? I'll also bring it up at the reliability review on Thursday.
Will do. And honestly, I'd like to swap out of on-call for the week of the twentieth because I'm traveling for a conference.
It's a search and retrieval conference in Berlin. I'm hoping to learn more about hybrid search for the indexing project.
That's perfect timing. Please write up a short summary of what you learn when you get back, and maybe share it at the engineering guild meeting. I'll handle the on-call swap with Jenna.
Sounds good. That's everything on my list.
One thing from me. Your peer feedback this cycle was excellent, especially around code reviews. Keep doing what you're doing. Talk next week.

summary.overview: Alex and Priya discussed Priya's growth toward a tech lead role and on-call load. Priya will lead the search infrastructure project next quarter, focused on incremental indexing, and will run her first design review with a draft due on the 28th. Three of her four recent pages came from a noisy queue-depth alert, and the team agreed to switch it to queue age. Priya is swapping out of on-call while she attends a search conference in Berlin.
